title: Define audio format and conversion domain types
description:
Create the shared audio-domain value types that describe sample formats, channel layouts, and format-conversion provenance throughout Abracapture.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- No prerequisite files; this task has disjoint write paths from other wave-1 tasks.

Do not infer APIs, schemas, behavior, or file contents; inspect the referenced files first.

Requirements:
1. src/core/AudioFormat.hpp must define:
   - `enum class SampleFormat : uint8_t` with values: Int16, Int24, Int32, Float32, Float64.
   - `struct AudioFormat` with fields: uint32_t sampleRate, uint16_t channels, SampleFormat sampleFormat.
   - Equality/inequality operators for AudioFormat.
   - `enum class ConversionProvenance : uint8_t` with values: Native, Quantized, Resampled, Converted. This enum records whether the captured audio is in its original format or was transformed.
   - `struct FormatConversion` with fields: AudioFormat source, AudioFormat target, ConversionProvenance provenance.
   - Free functions: `int bytesPerSample(SampleFormat)`, `int bytesPerFrame(const AudioFormat&)`, `std::string_view sampleFormatName(SampleFormat)`, `std::string_view provenanceName(ConversionProvenance)`.
2. src/core/AudioFormat.cpp must implement the free functions.
3. All types must be plain C++ with no Qt or PipeWire dependency.
4. Use constexpr where appropriate.
5. Include appropriate header guards or #pragma once.
acceptance_criteria: src/core/AudioFormat.hpp exists and defines SampleFormat enum class with Int16, Int24, Int32, Float32, Float64
src/core/AudioFormat.hpp defines struct AudioFormat with sampleRate, channels, sampleFormat fields and equality operators
src/core/AudioFormat.hpp defines ConversionProvenance enum class with Native, Quantized, Resampled, Converted
src/core/AudioFormat.hpp defines struct FormatConversion with source, target, provenance fields
src/core/AudioFormat.hpp declares bytesPerSample, bytesPerFrame, sampleFormatName, provenanceName free functions
src/core/AudioFormat.cpp implements all declared free functions
No Qt or PipeWire headers are included in either file
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify CMakeLists.txt or any cmake file

allowed: choose constexpr vs inline for free functions
forbidden: define types not listed in requirements
